title: Information Exchange Meeting Held with Private Companies and Organizations to Advance Dementia-Friendly Barrier-Free Society
summary: Niigata Prefecture hosted an information exchange meeting with private companies and organizations to promote the realization of a dementia-friendly barrier-free society.
body:
Niigata Prefecture hosted an information exchange meeting with private companies and organizations to promote the realization of a dementia-friendly barrier-free society.

Read more from the original source: [pref.niigata.lg.jp](https://www.pref.niigata.lg.jp/sec/kourei/ninchisho-barrier-free.html)
